cohort: 1606 births over a 9-month period at a university maternity hospital.
finding: High gestational risk was associated with both poor maternal and neonatal outcomes, while cesarean section alone was associated with poor neonatal outcome, but not maternal outcome.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with poor neonatal outcome (OR 3.4; 95%CI 2.7-4.4), but in multivariate analysis, accounting for gestational risk, the effect was reduced (OR 1.99; 95%CI 1.5-2.6).
